subject: english
prompt: A school poster says, “Bring a reusable bottle to reduce plastic waste.” What is the main idea?

options.text: Plastic waste can never be reduced.
Students should buy more single-use bottles.
Only one country has an environment.
A daily action can help protect the environment.

answer.explanation: Using a reusable bottle can reduce the number of disposable bottles used.
